content_sections.heading: Mayurbhanj District Court Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Mayurbhanj District Court Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, age limit and other requirements mentioned in the notification. Candidates must be citizens of India. Must have passed +3 Examination or equivalent qualification from a recognized university. Must have passed Diploma in Computer Application from a recognized institute. Must be able to read, write and speak Odia. Must have passed Odia language test equivalent to M.E. standard. Must have passed Matriculation or equivalent examination from a recognized Board. Must have passed Revenue Inspector Training. Must have operating knowledge of Computer. Must be able to read, write and speak Odia.

content_sections.heading: Mayurbhanj District Court Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: For Junior Clerk-Cum-Copyist, Grade-III Stenographer, Junior Typist and Salaried Amin posts, candidates should be above 18 years and below 42 years of age as on the last date fixed for receipt of applications, i.e. 07 September 2026. Age relaxation for reserved category candidates will be applicable as per relevant rules.

content_sections.heading: Mayurbhanj District Court Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for Mayurbhanj District Court Recruitment 2026 will be conducted through written examination, practical test and viva voce test. Written Examination Practical Test Viva Voce Test
